parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use correct double-angle formulae and express the left side in $\cos x,\sin x$ — M1. Obtain a correct expression — A1. Complete the method to get the correct denominator, e.g. factorise to remove $1-\cos x$ — M1. Obtain the given right side correctly — A1. OR work from right to left with $\frac{\sin x}{1+\cos x}\times\frac{1-\cos x}{1-\cos x}$ — M1A1, reach $\frac{2\sin x-2\sin x\cos x}{2-2\cos^2x}$ and hence the given result — M1A1. Guidance: given answer, check working carefully. Total: 4.
